abstract_summary: Monocular depth estimation is a fundamental capability for 3D spatial perception in robotic and intelligent systems. While data-driven discriminative methods have achieved compelling performance for monocular depth estimation, generative approaches can reconstruct fine structural details with stronger generalization...

evidence.excerpt:
sim-to-real and cross-scene generalization. The core
architecture first conducts coarse-level decoding conditioned on
diffused features extracted from a pre-trained semantic encoder,
and subsequently restores fine-grained structural patterns via
expanded decoding layers. Trained exclusively on a single syn-
thetic indoor dataset, our proposed method outperforms prior
methods across five real-world indoor and outdoor datasets,
yielding an average 14.1% reduction in relative error against
state-of-the-art works as well as 9.9% reduction in chamfer
distance for point cloud reconstruction. We further validate
the generalization capability of FlowMoDE on realistic robotic
scenes, with qualitative comparisons against state-of-the-art
methods. The project page is https://flowmode-shao.netlify.app/.

We utilize frozen DINOv2-B from MoGe as our semantic
encoder. The dimensions of semantic decoder, coarse decoder
and fine-grained decoder are respectively set to 384, 384
and 768. We train the proposed model on single dataset
Hypersim [28], which consists of 54K high-quality synthetic
indoor frames and corresponding depth maps. The proposed
model is trained for 200 epochs (2000 sampling steps for
each epoch) with a batch size of 4 and a fixed learning rate
of 1e-4, while all training samples are resized to 640×480.
All experiments are implemented on a NVIDIA H100 GPU.
B. Comparison Results: Monocular Depth Estimation
All methods are evaluated on five diverse real-world
datasets NYUv2 [29], KITTI [30], ETH3D [31], ScanNet
[32] and DIODE [33] following Marigold [10], resizing
all samples to a resolution with a long edge of 768. We
compared our model with existing discriminative models

evidence.excerpt:
In this paper, we present FlowMoDE, a flow-matching
generative model for sim-to-real monocular depth estimation
to recover fine structural details. Trained solely on synthetic
data, our model outperforms prior methods on five diverse
benchmarks. We further validate its strong ability to re-
construct fine-grained geometry in various robotic scenarios
against state-of-the-art approaches. With fewer Transformer
blocks and minimal inference steps, FlowMoDE is lighter
and more efficient than existing generative depth models.
Still, patch embedding in our flow-matching pipeline may
produce occasional flying pixels. Moreover, training only on
near-field indoor synthetic data combined with patch-wise
denoising can cause blurred edges for distant regions.

source_blocks.text:
In this paper, we present FlowMoDE, a flow-matching
generative model for sim-to-real monocular depth estimation
to recover fine structural details. Trained solely on synthetic
data, our model outperforms prior methods on five diverse
benchmarks. We further validate its strong ability to re-
construct fine-grained geometry in various robotic scenarios
against state-of-the-art approaches. With fewer Transformer
blocks and minimal inference steps, FlowMoDE is lighter
and more efficient than existing generative depth models.
Still, patch embedding in our flow-matching pipeline may
produce occasional flying pixels. Moreover, training only on
near-field indoor synthetic data combined with patch-wise
denoising can cause blurred edges for distant regions.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation is conducted on external, held-out real-world datasets (NYUv2, KITTI, ETH3D, ScanNet, DIODE) and 3D geometric point cloud metrics [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0027].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Zero-shot evaluation on five real-world datasets measuring absolute relative error, delta accuracy, point cloud Chamfer distance, and computational efficiency [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0024, E496d30410c596036-B0027, E496d30410c596036-B0038].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised MSE loss between the predicted velocity map and the analytical ground-truth velocity target on synthetic Hypersim data [E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0021, E496d30410c596036-B0023].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims of superior efficiency relative to generative diffusion baselines and competitive cross-dataset sim-to-real performance are supported by quantitative tables [E496d30410c596036-B0020, E496d30410c596036-B0027, E496d30410c596036-B0038].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The model is evaluated against major generative and discriminative baselines on five standard real-world datasets across relative depth and point cloud reconstruction metrics [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0027]. Detailed ablation studies systematically evaluate decoder block combinations, feature injection techniques, and flow matching step counts [E496d30410c596036-B0031, E496d30410c596036-B0036].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation is conducted on external, held-out real-world datasets (NYUv2, KITTI, ETH3D, ScanNet, DIODE) and 3D geometric point cloud metrics [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0027].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Zero-shot evaluation on five real-world datasets measuring absolute relative error, delta accuracy, point cloud Chamfer distance, and computational efficiency [E496d30410c596036-B0018, E496d30410c596036-B0024, E496d30410c596036-B0027, E496d30410c596036-B0038].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Supervised MSE loss between the predicted velocity map and the analytical ground-truth velocity target on synthetic Hypersim data [E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0021, E496d30410c596036-B0023].

primary.limitations: The authors transparently report that patch embedding can introduce flying pixels and that training solely on indoor synthetic data causes blurred boundaries in distant regions [E496d30410c596036-B0039].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is explicitly defined, detailing the conditional flow matching formulation, token modulation, single-step training loss, and two-step inference procedure [E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0021, E496d30410c596036-B0022]. Architecture components and training hyperparameters are adequately documented [E496d30410c596036-B0014, E496d30410c596036-B0023].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a clear and technically sound method, thoroughly validated across multiple external standard benchmarks with solid ablations and explicit discussion of failure modes and efficiency trade-offs.
primary.scoped_contribution: FlowMoDE introduces a coarse-to-fine flow-matching architecture that uses a frozen DINOv2 semantic encoder and modulated decoders for efficient, 2-step sim-to-real monocular depth estimation trained only on synthetic data [E496d30410c596036-B0002, E496d30410c596036-B0013, E496d30410c596036-B0023].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a clear and technically sound method, thoroughly validated across multiple external standard benchmarks with solid ablations and explicit discussion of failure modes and efficiency trade-offs.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently report that patch embedding can introduce flying pixels and that training solely on indoor synthetic data causes blurred boundaries in distant regions [E496d30410c596036-B0039].

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.

research_relevance.value: Directly relevant to computer-vision research based on screening evidence.
